mechanism: Galantamine (cholinesterase inhibitor) increases acetylcholine which enhances parasympathetic activity, while lisdexamfetamine (sympathomimetic) increases sympathetic activity, creating opposing autonomic effects and potential cardiac/CNS complications.
action: Monitor heart rate, blood pressure, and cardiac rhythm closely; use with caution in patients with cardiac conditions; consider alternative stimulant or cholinesterase inhibitor if interaction becomes clinically problematic.
